meta.title: Invoice Assignment for Processing: refused for a user without the AP Manager role
gaps: Open or use Invoice Assignment for Processing
Sign in as a user without the AP Manager role and verify the action is refused or absent
Repeat the action as an AP Manager and verify it is available
Verify the tenant is on the Growth or Enterprise plan
Compare both personas on the same tenant and record any deliberate RBAC configuration
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open or use Invoice Assignment for Processing; Sign in as a user without the AP Manager role and verify the action is refused or absent; Repeat the action as an AP Manager and verify it is available; Verify the tenant is on the Growth or Enterprise plan; Compare both personas on the same tenant and record any deliberate RBAC configuration

args.need: sign in as a user without the AP Manager role, attempt Invoice Assignment for Processing and record whether it is refused or absent, then repeat as an AP Manager on the same Growth-or-Enterprise tenant and record whether it is available

steps.note: The catalog cannot reach the invoice assignment workflow or switch between role-specific user sessions.
Provides the required final assertion after the tester comparison without claiming that the invoice permission behavior was observed by a catalog step.
